# schema/async_poll_stateless — valid spec produces no diagnostics and exits 0
# No testserver needed; validate performs static analysis only.

exec skopos validate -i spec.yml
! stderr .
! stdout .

-- spec.yml --
ir_version: "1"

# async_job sibling of async_poll.yml that exercises
# `on_complete.cursor_update.kind: stateless` — the cursor does NOT advance
# at job-end. Appropriate for async pulls that are already idempotent at the
# server layer (e.g. "always re-fetch the last 24h export"), where the
# operator wants every drain to re-issue submit with the same parameters.

state:
  fields:
    url:
      type: url
      default: "http://localhost:9999"
    api_key:
      type: secret
      default: "test-bearer-token-12345"

defaults:
  base_url: {ref: state.url}

auth:
  bearer:
    token: {ref: state.api_key}

requests:
  - id: submit
    method: POST
    path: /api/v1/exports
    expect_status: [202]

  - id: poll
    method: GET
    path:
      concat:
        - /api/v1/exports/
        - {ref: cursor.export_id}
        - /status

  - id: fetch
    method: GET
    url: {ref: cursor.result_url}

response:
  decode: json
  events_at: items

pagination:
  none: {}

progress:
  async_job:
    submit:
      step: submit
      extract:
        export_id: {path: export_id}
    poll:
      step: poll
      complete_when:
        eq:
          path: body.status
          equal: complete
      extract:
        result_url: {path: result_url}
    fetch:
      step: fetch
    on_complete:
      cursor_update:
        kind: stateless

error:
  mode: standard
